title: ChatReply
body:
# ChatReply (Client Mod)

![The official logo showcasing the ChatReply mod branding](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1771052704790-8a910c41-25d2-46c3-9440-33c20b599866.png)

A lightweight, client-side mod that automatically responds to configurable chat messages and handles scheduled text intervals.

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/elQNnDre?style=for-the-badge&color=00AF5C&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/elQNnDre) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/web-aboutcapy.dev-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=icloud&logoColor=white)](https://aboutcapy.dev) [![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/wiki-docs.aboutcapy.dev-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=readme&logoColor=white)](https://docs.aboutcapy.dev/chatreply) 

## Features

* **Auto-Response**: Triggers customized replies to specific phrases.
* **Message Recall**: Instantly access and reuse previous chat history.
* **Response Delay**: Prevent instant replies by adding a custom time buffer.
* **Scheduled Loop**: Send text automatically at custom intervals (e.g., every 10s or 20s).
* **In-Game GUI**: Toggle features and modify settings on the fly.
* **Quick Keybinds**: Enable, disable, or open menus instantly via hotkeys.
* **Client-Side**: Runs purely on your system with zero server footprint.

## Configuration Menu

ChatReply features a clean, in-game configuration menu. All changes take effect immediately without requiring a game restart.

### Auto-Respond Settings
* **Toggle**: Instantly enable or disable the automated response engine.
* **Watch For**: Define the exact keyword or phrase that triggers the mod.
* **Reply With**: Set the custom message sent back when triggered.

### Delayed Messages
* **Interval Loops**: Create automated messages that broadcast at custom times.
* **Live Editing**: Tweak the output text and timing delays directly in-game.

## Commands

```text
/chatreply on                     - Enables automatic chat responding
/chatreply off                    - Disables automatic chat responding
/chatreply setmessage <text>      - Sets the trigger phrase to listen for
/chatreply setresponse <text>     - Sets the automated reply message
/chatreply senddelay <text> <sec> - Loops a message at custom intervals
/chatreply stopsenddelay          - Stops the active scheduled interval loop
```

## Keybinds

* **C** — Opens the message recall menu.
* **H** — Toggles the entire response system on or off.
* **I** — Opens the main configuration GUI.

*Note: All hotkeys can be remapped anytime in the standard Minecraft controls menu.*

## Installation & Recommendations

### Setup Guide
1. Download the mod file matching your Minecraft version.
2. Place the file inside your local client `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and type `/chatreply` to verify installation.

### Recommendations
* **Always Update**: Use the latest file version for the best stability.
* **Interface Scaling**: Set your game GUI size to **3** for the best layout look.

## Client Compatibility

This mod runs on standard Minecraft clients supporting client-side mods, and has been tested on:
* Feather Client
* Lunar Client

*Note: Total compatibility with all third-party launchers cannot be guaranteed.*

## Transparency & Security

* **Purely Client-Side**: Runs exclusively on your game instance.
* **No Data Collection**: Does not gather, store, or transmit personal details.
* **No Account Tracking**: Never accesses tokens, passwords, or session data.
* **No External Links**: Does not connect to outside master servers.
* **Vanilla Mimicry**: Dispatches messages safely through standard vanilla chat protocols.

## Server Warning & Disclaimer

> ⚠️ **Important Warning**: This mod automates chat actions. Many multiplayer servers classify this behavior as a macro or illegal automation. Using this mod on public servers that restrict automation can result in player mutes, kicks, or permanent account bans.

### User Responsibility
* You must verify individual server rules regarding chat macros.
* You assume full responsibility for any server punishments or bans incurred.
* The developer holds zero liability for rule violations or player bans.

### Suggested Use Cases
* Personal or private survival worlds.
* Servers where automated chat macros are explicitly permitted.
* Repetitive AFK status messages with pre-approved staff consent.
